request: Select by validation CER only; prefer earlier epoch within a small margin; record per-field CER and training configuration; establish test exclusion.
missing: Validation CER per field on the same fixed reviewed validation set

selection_policy.proposed_aggregate: Micro CER = total validation character edits / total reference characters across eligible fields; field CERs also recorded. This matches the existing annotation protocol.
selection_policy.tie_break: Earliest epoch among checkpoints within the declared absolute CER margin of the minimum; then earliest training step if available.
selection_policy.margin_status: Proposed in clarification; not applied because no candidate metrics are available.

test_boundary.reason: Historical checkpoint training manifests and actual run provenance are unavailable. Earlier OCR preparation identified unresolved legacy held-out links; these are not evidence of a particular checkpoint having trained on them.

recheck.finding: Available branch histories contain detector results.csv reports but no OCR trainer_state or per-checkpoint CER reports. Detector precision/mAP reports cannot select an OCR checkpoint by CER.
